description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for follow-related operations such as follow, unfollow, listing followers, and listing following users, each associated with specific URL endpoints and HTTP methods.

methods.name: follow
methods.description: Handles the follow action for a user with specified username

methods.name: unfollow
methods.description: Handles the unfollow action for a user with specified username

methods.name: followers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of followers for a user

methods.name: following
methods.description: Retrieves the list of users the specified user is following
